data.title: 2% of your taxes for the Hradiská civic association
data.excerpt: There is still time until the end of April to donate 2% of your taxes to our civic association. In 2018 the money paid for information panels, for fees connected with videos made with Dwarf Digital and for survey equipment; this year it will help us publish the new volume Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias 2.
data.metaTitle: 2% of your taxes for the Hradiská association
data.metaDescription: Until the end of April you can donate 2% of your taxes to the Hradiská civic association; last year the money went to information panels and videos.

children.text:
There is still time until the end of April to donate 2% of your taxes to our association. We used the money from the previous 2% in 2018 for a number of important activities, for example to cover the costs of producing information panels, fees connected with some of the videos made in collaboration with Dwarf Digital (the recorded commentary), some of the costs connected with preparing the book Skryté poklady (Hidden Treasures) and the purchase of equipment for archaeological surveys.
 
 This year your 2% will be of great help to us in publishing the new volume Hradiská – Svedkovia dávnych čias 2 (Hillforts – Witnesses of Ancient Times 2). Anyone who donates 2% to us should write and tell me so when ordering the volume, and will receive it free of charge.
You can download the form for donating 2%
